assets.prompt: Create one original square equipment icon for Grave Accord, a hand-painted 2D gothic fantasy bullet hell game. It belongs to Ranger Nela Venn, a former water survey assistant. Use emphatic dark hand-inked contours, broad matte gouache shapes in three distinct value groups, weathered ash wood, muted river-reed green, tarnished warm brass, warm off-white highlights. Restrained handmade utility gear from the same workshop. It must read cleanly at 32 pixels. One centered complete silhouette, a generous 12 percent genuinely transparent alpha margin all around and true transparent background. No setting, floor shadow, frame, UI border, plate backing unrelated to the object, text, letters, numbers, magic, glow, smoke, gradient backdrop or loose confetti. A short ash arrow fragment with an off-white feather is pinned across the edge by one dark practical leather strap. The tablet and arrow overlap into one rugged triangular silhouette. Give the single existing track room to read.
